---
title: "stGradient: Regenerate Vignette Figures"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
params:
  rds_path: "path/to/sample_seuratObject.rds"
  fov_name: "fov"
  celltype_col: "singleR.predicted.id.brcaAtlas"
  cancer_labels: !r c("Cancer LumA SC", "Cancer LumB SC", "Cancer Her2 SC")
  group_by: "singleR.predicted.id.brcaAtlas"
  sample_label: "Sample_01"
  assay: "Xenium"
  fig_dir: "vignettes"
  extra_dir: "vignette_figures_output"
  load_all: true
  dbscan_eps: 35
  dbscan_minPts: 20
  use_optimized_dbscan: false
  dbscan_max_sample: 10000
  pcf_distance: 200
  pcf_nsim: 39
  pcf_pair: !r NULL
  run_tls: true
  tls_celltype_col: "first_type"
  tls_b_types: !r c("B_Cells")
  tls_t_types: !r c("CD4+_T_Cells", "CD8+_T_Cells")
  tls_dc_types: !r c("LAMP3+_DCs", "IRF7+_DCs")
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>",
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 9,
  fig.height = 6
)
```

This document runs the stGradient workflow exactly as laid out in the package
vignettes and writes every figure the vignettes embed to `r params$fig_dir`/,
overwriting the existing PNGs. Render it from the repository root, then commit
the updated PNGs; the pkgdown GitHub Action rebuilds the site on push.

```r
rmarkdown::render("vignette_figures.Rmd",
                  params = list(rds_path = "/path/to/sample.rds"))
```

Non-figure outputs (the multi-page PCF envelope PDF) go to
`r params$extra_dir`/, which is git-ignored.

## Setup

```{r packages}
if (isTRUE(params$load_all) && requireNamespace("pkgload", quietly = TRUE)) {
  pkgload::load_all(".", quiet = TRUE)
} else {
  library(stGradient)
}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

fig_dir <- params$fig_dir
extra_dir <- params$extra_dir
dir.create(fig_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(extra_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Save a ggplot/patchwork/cowplot object to fig_dir and show it in the report
save_fig <- function(plot, file, width, height, dpi = 150) {
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, file), plot,
                  width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  print(plot)
  invisible(plot)
}

# For functions that draw directly to the device instead of returning a plot
save_device <- function(file, width, height, expr, res = 150, bg = "white") {
  path <- file.path(fig_dir, file)
  grDevices::png(path, width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = res, bg = bg)
  out <- tryCatch(force(expr), finally = grDevices::dev.off())
  print(knitr::include_graphics(path))
  invisible(out)
}
```

## Loading & Setup

```{r load-data}
seurat_obj <- load_xenium_seurat(
  rds_path = params$rds_path,
  celltype_col = params$celltype_col,
  cancer_labels = params$cancer_labels
)
seurat_obj
table(seurat_obj$is_cancer)
```

## Region Selection

### Optimizing DBSCAN Parameters

```{r optimize-dbscan}
# max_sample caps the silhouette distance matrix (n^2 memory) for large samples
dbscan_results <- optimize_dbscan_params(seurat_obj, fov_name = params$fov_name,
                                         max_sample = params$dbscan_max_sample)
head(dbscan_results)
```

#### Evaluating Polygon Coverage and Purity

```{r optimize-dbscan-coverage}
eval_polys <- function(obj, eps, minPts, fov = params$fov_name) {
  polys <- plot_dbscan_polygons(obj, fov = fov, eps = eps, minPts = minPts, plot = FALSE)
  if (is.null(polys)) return(NULL)
  coords <- Seurat::GetTissueCoordinates(obj, image = fov)
  coords$is_cancer <- as.logical(obj$is_cancer)
  pts    <- sf::st_as_sf(coords, coords = c("x", "y"))
  region <- sf::st_union(sf::st_make_valid(polys))
  inside <- lengths(sf::st_intersects(pts, region)) > 0
  data.frame(eps = eps, minPts = minPts, n_regions = nrow(polys),
             cancer_covered = mean(inside[coords$is_cancer]),
             purity         = mean(coords$is_cancer[inside]))
}

cand <- subset(dbscan_results, noise_pct < 0.15)[, c("eps", "minPts")]
scores <- do.call(rbind, Map(eval_polys, list(seurat_obj), cand$eps, cand$minPts))

if (!is.null(scores) && nrow(scores) > 0) {
  scores <- scores[order(-scores$cancer_covered, -scores$purity), ]
  scores$label <- paste0(scores$eps, "/", scores$minPts)
  b <- 0.5
  scores$fbeta <- with(scores, (1 + b^2) * purity * cancer_covered /
                         (b^2 * purity + cancer_covered))
  print(head(scores, 10))

  long <- pivot_longer(scores, c(cancer_covered, purity),
                       names_to = "metric", values_to = "value")

  p_cov <- ggplot(long, aes(factor(eps), factor(minPts), fill = value)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", value)), size = 2.8) +
    facet_wrap(~ metric, ncol = 1) +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::percent) +
    labs(x = "eps", y = "minPts", fill = NULL) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank())

  save_fig(p_cov, "dbscan_coverage_purity.png", width = 8, height = 7)
} else {
  message("No DBSCAN candidates with noise_pct < 0.15; skipping coverage/purity plot.")
}
```

### DBSCAN-Based Polygon Detection

```{r dbscan}
if (isTRUE(params$use_optimized_dbscan)) {
  dbscan_eps <- dbscan_results$eps[1]
  dbscan_minPts <- dbscan_results$minPts[1]
} else {
  dbscan_eps <- params$dbscan_eps
  dbscan_minPts <- params$dbscan_minPts
}
cat("Using eps =", dbscan_eps, "and minPts =", dbscan_minPts, "\n")

seurat_obj <- add_dbscan_polygons(seurat_obj, fov_name = params$fov_name,
                                  eps = dbscan_eps, minPts = dbscan_minPts)
auto_polygons <- get_cancer_regions(seurat_obj, fov_name = params$fov_name)
auto_polygons
```

```{r plot-dbscan}
save_device("plot_dbscan_polygons.png", width = 9.8, height = 5.8, bg = "black",
            plot_dbscan_polygons(seurat_obj, fov = params$fov_name,
                                 eps = dbscan_eps, minPts = dbscan_minPts,
                                 sample_name = params$sample_label))
```

## Distance Metrics

### Boundary Distances

```{r boundary-dist}
seurat_obj$boundary_distance <- calculate_boundary_distances(
  seurat_obj, auto_polygons, fov_name = params$fov_name
)
summary(seurat_obj$boundary_distance)
```

### Distance Profile Analysis

```{r profile}
results_all <- calculate_distance_profile(
  seurat_obj = seurat_obj,
  distance_thresholds = seq(10, 200, by = 10),
  metric = "all",
  group_by = params$group_by,
  inside_mode = "all"
)
results_dist <- calculate_distance_profile(
  seurat_obj = seurat_obj,
  distance_thresholds = seq(10, 200, by = 10),
  metric = "all",
  group_by = params$group_by,
  inside_mode = "distance"
)

distance_profile <- results_all$profile
celltype_contributions <- results_all$celltype_contributions
combined <- rbind(results_all$profile, results_dist$profile)
head(combined)
```

### Critical Distances

```{r critical}
critical <- find_critical_distance(distance_profile, "transcriptomic_distance")
cat("Maximum separation at:", critical$max_distance, "μm\n")
cat("Plateau begins at:", critical$plateau_distance, "μm\n")
```

## PCF Analysis

```{r pcf-summary}
pcf_summary <- calculate_pcf_outside_summary(
  seurat_obj = seurat_obj,
  polygons = auto_polygons,
  distance = params$pcf_distance,
  min_cells = 10,
  celltype_col = params$celltype_col,
  fov_name = params$fov_name,
  include_self_pairs = TRUE,
  ordered_pairs = FALSE
)
head(pcf_summary[order(-pcf_summary$g_value), ])
```

```{r pcf-heatmap}
save_fig(plot_pcf_outside_heatmap(pcf_summary, midpoint = 1),
         "plot_pcf_outside_heatmap.png", width = 5.8, height = 4.9)
```

```{r pcf-envelopes}
env_list <- plot_pcf_outside_pair_envelopes(
  seurat_obj = seurat_obj,
  polygons = auto_polygons,
  celltype_col = params$celltype_col,
  fov_name = params$fov_name,
  min_cells = 10,
  include_self_pairs = FALSE,
  ordered_pairs = FALSE,
  nsim = params$pcf_nsim,
  bw = 10,
  file = file.path(extra_dir, "pcf_outside_all_pairs.pdf")
)
length(env_list)
```

```{r pcf-single}
# Use the requested pair, otherwise the strongest non-self pair from the summary
if (!is.null(params$pcf_pair)) {
  pcf_pair <- params$pcf_pair
} else {
  cross <- pcf_summary[pcf_summary$type1 != pcf_summary$type2 &
                         is.finite(pcf_summary$g_value), ]
  cross <- cross[order(-cross$g_value), ]
  ok <- paste(cross$type1, "vs", cross$type2) %in% names(Filter(Negate(is.null), env_list)) |
        paste(cross$type2, "vs", cross$type1) %in% names(Filter(Negate(is.null), env_list))
  pcf_pair <- unlist(cross[which(ok)[1], c("type1", "type2")])
}
cat("Single-pair PCF:", pcf_pair[1], "vs", pcf_pair[2], "\n")

save_fig(plot_pcf_pair_gg(env_list, pcf_pair[1], pcf_pair[2]),
         "pcfSinglePlot.png", width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```


## TLS Analysis

```{r tls-check}
run_tls <- isTRUE(params$run_tls) &&
  params$tls_celltype_col %in% colnames(seurat_obj@meta.data)
if (!run_tls) {
  message("Skipping TLS section: set run_tls = TRUE and make sure '",
          params$tls_celltype_col, "' is a metadata column.")
}
```

```{r call-tls, eval = run_tls}
seurat_obj <- call_tls(
  seurat_obj,
  fov_name = params$fov_name,
  celltype_col = params$tls_celltype_col,
  b_types = params$tls_b_types,
  t_types = params$tls_t_types,
  dc_types = params$tls_dc_types,
  eps = 50,
  minPts = 20,
  min_B = 20,
  min_T = 20,
  min_frac_B = 0.05
)
get_tls_summary(seurat_obj, fov_name = params$fov_name)
```

```{r plot-tls-map, eval = run_tls}
save_fig(plot_tls_map(seurat_obj, fov_name = params$fov_name,
                      celltype_col = params$tls_celltype_col,
                      b_types = params$tls_b_types),
         "plot_tls_map.png", width = 8, height = 6)
save_fig(plot_tls_composition(seurat_obj, celltype_col = params$tls_celltype_col),
         "plot_tls_composition.png", width = 8, height = 5)
```

```{r add-score, eval = run_tls}
tls_signature_genes()
seurat_obj <- add_tls_score(seurat_obj, assay = params$assay)
```

```{r plot-score, eval = run_tls}
save_fig(plot_tls_score(seurat_obj, fov_name = params$fov_name, highlight = "outline"),
         "plot_tls_score_outline.png", width = 8, height = 6)
save_fig(plot_tls_score(seurat_obj, fov_name = params$fov_name, highlight = "ring",
                        label_tls = TRUE),
         "plot_tls_score_ring.png", width = 8, height = 6)
save_fig(plot_tls_score(seurat_obj, fov_name = params$fov_name, highlight = "none"),
         "plot_tls_score_none.png", width = 8, height = 6)
```

```{r compare-score, eval = run_tls}
tls_stats <- summarize_tls_score(seurat_obj)
tls_stats$by_status
tls_stats$by_tls
tls_stats$wilcox_p

save_fig(plot_tls_score_comparison(seurat_obj, type = "beeswarm"),
         "plot_tls_score_beeswarm.png", width = 6, height = 4.5)
save_fig(plot_tls_score_comparison(seurat_obj, type = "violin"),
         "plot_tls_score_violin.png", width = 6, height = 4.5)
```
